title: Use Bambus2 Scaffolding Module
author: Afiahayati
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d7n9md
materials: Identify genomic repeats and output them.

steps.title: Install Bambus2 software
steps.instruction: Download and install the Bambus2 programs from http://www.cbcb.umd.edu/software/bambus/.

steps.title: Run Velvet preprocessing
steps.instruction: Execute velveth and velvetg exactly as described in the Velvet "Getting started" protocol, then verify that the files out-dir/Sequences, out-dir/Roadmaps, and out-dir/Graph2 have been created.

substeps.instruction: Run velveth with the appropriate parameters for your dataset.
Run velvetg on the generated hash.
Check that out-dir/Sequences, out-dir/Roadmaps, and out-dir/Graph2 exist.

steps.title: Run meta‑velvetg
steps.instruction: Execute meta‑velvetg on the Velvet output directory with the options –ins_length 260, –exp_covs 214_122_70_43_25_13.5, –amos_file yes, and –scaffolding no; then confirm that out-dir/meta-velvetg.asm.afg has been created.

steps.title: Create AMOS bank
steps.instruction: Build an AMOS bank from the meta‑velvetg assembly file using the command: bank-transact -m out-dir/meta-velvetg.asm.afg -b bank-dir -cf.

steps.title: Construct contig links
steps.instruction: Use the paired‑end read information to construct a collection of contig links.

steps.title: Bundle contig links
steps.instruction: Bundle the contig links into a collection of contig edges.

steps.title: Order and orient contigs
steps.instruction: Order and orient the contigs according to repeat and link information.

steps.title: Export contig FASTA
steps.instruction: Generate a FASTA file of the contigs with: bank2fasta -d -b bank-dir | tee contig-file.

steps.title: Obtain final scaffold FASTA
steps.instruction: The resulting scaffold file (scaffold-file) contains the final scaffolding results in FASTA format.
